crew.overview: In 1962 Hong Kong, neighbors Su Li-zhen (Mrs. Chan) and Chow Mo-wan (Mr. Chow) discover their spouses are having an affair. As they spend time together, they develop feelings for each other, but their relationship remains chaste and unspoken, reflecting societal constraints and their own moral compass.
crew.title: In the Mood for Love

details.biography: Tang Shiang-chu (Chinese: 湯湘竹, born in 1964) is a Taiwanese film director and sound designer. He was graduated from the National Taiwan College of Arts. He is currently a senior soundperson at the Tu Duu-chi Recording Studio.
details.name: Tang Shiang-Chu
